convert_pixtral_weights_to_hf: convert Pixtral model weights from Mistral format to HuggingFace Transformers format
convert_mistral_tokenizer: convert a Mistral tokenizer file to a HuggingFace LlamaTokenizer with proper special tokens
convert_mistral_model: convert a Mistral Pixtral model checkpoint directory to a HuggingFace LlavaForConditionalGeneration model
convert_dictionary: map old Mistral-style state dict keys to new HuggingFace key names and apply RoPE permutation
permute_for_rope: apply rotary position embedding permutation to query and key projection weights
